position_language_rif.md.tongue: Tarifit, the Riffian Amazigh of the Rif coast
position_language_rif.md.note: Written in Tarifit in Latin script, the convention of Riffian writing in Morocco and the diaspora; Tifinagh, official in Morocco since 2003, is not used in the city it came from. Registered as `rif` in the house's `khai.languages`, which routes it to assisted verification instead of the local detector. Read against the mnemonic when it moved here: two claims about Melilla, its households and its schools, were cut, because a position says what a tongue does to whoever holds it and not what a city does about it. The Rif stays, as the speech community that holds the tongue.

position_language_es_es_ce.md.tongue: Ceutan Spanish, Andalusian in its sounds and full of Darija that nobody hears as borrowed
position_language_es_es_ce.md.note: Read against the mnemonic on the way through: it opened by placing itself on the African shore of the Strait, and where is not one of the four, so it now names the community that speaks it instead. Everything else is the office: the Darija it holds without translating, the register it forces at the official counter, the maritime lexicon it is losing with the trades.

position_language_es_es_ml.md.tongue: Melillan Spanish, close to the standard and carrying the complete vocabulary of accreditation
position_language_es_es_ml.md.note: Read against the mnemonic on the way through: two things were cut from its opening. It placed itself on the Rif coast, and where is not one of the four; and it explained its own closeness to the standard by who lives in the city, its garrison and its civil service, which is a claim about a place and not about a tongue. What stays is the strongest thing it says: that it orders its holder to state where they are from and since when before saying what they want.

position_language_de_de_be.md.note: Read against the mnemonic on the way through: nothing needed cutting, because it claims nothing about a culture. It has the opposite fault. Its four chapters describe Standard German and name no feature of this variety at all: no Berliner Schnauze, no icke, no wat or det, no j for initial g, and not the accusative-dative merger the city makes jokes about. That is the defining question asked of a tongue rather than of a play, and it is left standing here rather than answered by invention. It is not a copy of its neighbours - the three thin varieties share under half their text - each was written thin on its own.

position_language_de_de_ni.md.note: Read against the mnemonic on the way through: it names itself and the language beneath it, which is the tongue's own business, so nothing was cut. It is the strongest of this batch, because it explains its own unmarkedness by the substrate it was laid over.

position_language_de_de_mv.md.tongue: Mecklenburg-Vorpommern Standard German, learned late and laid over Platt
position_language_de_de_mv.md.note: Read against the mnemonic on the way through: one clause was cut, and the sorted drift queue is what found it. It said its clear pronunciation once counted as the norm für ganz Deutschland, naming the culture above rather than the standard itself; it now says it served the Bühnenaussprache as a model and entered the checked Hochlautung from there, which is the same fact told about the language. What stayed is the industries its maritime lexicon is losing ground to, because that is a cause of lexical loss and so belongs to Loses, the same shape kept in Ceutan Spanish.

position_language_de_de_rp.md.tongue: Rhineland-Palatinate Standard German, Palatine softness under the standard
position_language_de_de_rp.md.note: Read against the mnemonic on the way through: one clause was cut. It now says what the diminutive does to everything it names.
